documents.name: The unbearable emptiness of tweeting—About journal articles

source.author: Nicolas Robinson-Garcia; Rodrigo Costas; Kimberley Isett; Julia Melkers; Diana Hicks
source.locator: Non-contiguous excerpts: Background quotation + Abstract results; arranged thematically, not original adjacency

evidence.paragraphText: Twitter citations are also uniquely conversational, reflecting a broader discussion crossing traditional disciplinary boundaries.
evidence.holder: Priem & Costello (2010)，由 Robinson-Garcia 等 (2017) 引述
evidence.stanceQuote: We see much presumably human tweeting almost entirely mechanical and devoid of original thought, no evidence of conversation, tweets generated by monomania, duplicate tweeting from many accounts under centralized professional management and tweets generated by bots. Some accounts exemplify the ideal, but they represent less than 10% of tweets. Therefore, any conclusions drawn from twitter data is swamped by the mechanical nature of the bulk of tweeting behavior.
